name: Unscrew VR
summary:
Unscrew VR is a cozy, oddly satisfying VR puzzle game where you take toys apart screw by screw. Pick up objects, rotate them in your hands, and dismantle them piece by piece at your own pace.

✅ Major update: Daily Tasks
Jump in for a quick relaxing session each day, complete simple goals, and earn rewards.

Why you’ll love it

Oddly satisfying disassembly gameplay — play slow and chill or fast and snappy
Hands-on VR interaction: hold, rotate, and inspect toys from any angle
Hidden parts and “toy inside toy
